component.name: shadersweep
component.summary: See and clear Steam shader cache disk usage

description.p: shadersweep shows how much disk space each Steam game's shader cache uses, highlights caches left behind by uninstalled games, and lets you clear them safely (to the Trash by default). Proton prefixes and game files are never touched.
shadersweep is an independent project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Valve Corporation.
